extension.name: plg_system_claudecoworkupdate
extension.author: Tracy
extension.description: Takes the updates Tracy announces for this site, without waiting for somebody to press a button in the backend. Joomla shows an extension update and then waits; WordPress installs it. This plugin gives Joomla the WordPress behaviour for Tracy's own extensions only. Installed and updated as part of the Claude Cowork package.

field.name: autoupdate
field.label: Install updates automatically
field.description: When off, updates are only shown in Extensions → Update, as Joomla does for every other extension.
